src/data/neighborhoods.ts.rationale: Contains the canonical Tehran neighborhoods seed dataset, landmarks, and core evaluation formulas.

src/data/neighborhoodInsights.ts.rationale: Contains street-by-street Micro-Hoods, schools, metro stations, and hidden traps for neighborhoods.

src/data/multiCityData.ts.rationale: Contains seed datasets for Karaj, Mashhad, Isfahan, and Shiraz plus statutory commission tables.

src/data/tehranCityRemainingHoods.ts.rationale: Contains static seed dataset for remaining Tehran city neighborhoods (IDs 36..60).

src/data/tehranCountiesHoods.ts.rationale: Contains static seed dataset for Tehran province counties and suburbs (IDs 61..80).

src/data/tehranExtendedInsights.ts.rationale: Contains static growth, traffic, and street-level insights for extended Tehran neighborhoods (IDs 36..99).

src/data/iranNorthWestEastHoods.ts.rationale: Contains static seed dataset for North, North-West, East, and North-East Iran neighborhoods.

src/data/iranCentralSouthHoods.ts.rationale: Contains static seed dataset for Central, Zagros, South, and Persian Gulf Iran neighborhoods.

src/data/iranProvincesDirectory.ts.rationale: Contains static directory of all 31 Iranian provinces and their target coordinates.

src/App.tsx.rationale: Root composition & provider shell; decomposed to 62 lines (< 100 LOC per ARGON-4 [RULE-01]) with layout extracted to src/components/RadarWorkspaceShell.tsx.
